title: MZ Making Weapons with multiple Weapon Types?

posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
I am using Visustella Plugins in an RPG Maker MZ game. I thought that
Items and Equips Core
might have something, but I didn't see anything.
I want to separate weapons into 2 categories
1: Simple\Advance\Special Weapons to help sort equipment
and their types.
2: Sword\Daggers\Hammers\etc. for use with skills.
Any recommendations on scripts that could possibly do this??

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya,
From what you linked there, would the category notetags not do what you were looking for?
They allow you to set items/equipment to be attached to multiple categories, which you would then be able to have show up as tabs in the inventory itself so things with each related tag would show up in each.
Items and Equips Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
So you specify these categories in the plugin settings under 'category list' as needed.
Hopefully that helps!
